meta.config:
# 所有參數放這裡（PLAN v2.0）。標「初值」的門檻只能在開發集上調，11/2 凍結後另存 configs/frozen.yaml。
seed: 2026

paths:
  raw: data/raw
  catalog: data/catalog.csv
  index: data/index
  synthetic: data/synthetic
  extract: work/extract
  page_graph: work/page_graph
  logo_refs: work/logo_refs
  context: work/context
  evidence: work/evidence
  features: work/features
  reuse: work/reuse
  prompts: configs/prompts
  annotations: annotations
  results: results
  reports: reports

data:
  years: [2023, 2024, 2025]          # 報告年度（報告涵蓋的會計年度）
  n_firms: 150
  n_dev: 30                          # 以公司為單位
  dev_must_include: ["1101", "1707"] # 台泥、葡萄王

extract:
  crop_long_side: 1024
  jpg_quality: 90

page_graph:
  container_min_area: 0.02           # 色塊容器面積下限（占頁面比例）
  container_max_area: 0.90
  heading_levels: 3                  # 章、節、小標題

logo_refs:
  min_pages: 3                       # 出現幾頁以上的小圖算候選
  min_short_side_pt: 20
  use_cover: true

photo_filter:
  model: ViT-L-14
  pretrained: openai
  exclude_first_last_page: true
  photo_prompts: ["a photograph of a real scene", "a photograph of people"]
  nonphoto_prompts: ["an illustration", "a chart or infographic", "a logo or icon",
                     "a scanned certificate or document", "an abstract graphic design"]

context_link:
  model: logistic_regression
  max_body_blocks: 2
  baselines: [nearest_paragraph, same_column_nearest, caption_only, section_heading_only, rules_v1]

evidence:
  llm: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct      # 開工時確認可用，記錄 revision
  vlm: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct   # 或 Qwen3-VL-8B
  temperature: 0
  ocr: paddleocr_chinese_cht
  depiction_threshold: 0.5           # 初值
  topical_threshold: 0.5             # 初值
  ocr_match_threshold: 0.7           # 初值：字元二元組重疊
  logo_min_inliers: 15               # 初值
  years_roc_offset: 1911
  baselines: [chinese_clip_vitl14, vlm_direct_zeroshot, vlm_direct_fewshot]

reuse:
  global_models: [dinov2_vitb14, sscd_disc_mixup]
  topk: 10
  years_back: [1]
  use_flip: true
  matcher: superpoint_lightglue
  ransac: magsac
  min_inliers: 25                    # 初值
  min_coverage: 0.30                 # 初值
  stock_topk_other_firms: 5

synthetic:
  n_pos: 1000
  n_neg: 5000
  crop_keep_area: [0.5, 0.9]
  brightness_contrast: 0.30
  saturation: 0.50
  hue_deg: 10
  overlay_text_area: [0.10, 0.30]
  jpeg_quality: [50, 90]
  collage_area: [0.40, 0.70]

evaluation:
  bootstrap_unit: firm
  bootstrap_n: 2000
  ci: 0.95
meta.method: AI-assisted check, not ground truth. 5 Claude subagents (claude-opus-5-5), 30 firms each. Inputs per report: page 1 image (45 dpi; the three years side by side), page 2-3 images (36 dpi) when needed, text of pages 1-3 (PyMuPDF). Rules: firm_ok = the company name, English name or logo is visible; year_ok = cover year or stated reporting period equals the catalog year. Anything not yes/yes would get a second look with pages 1-8; none needed it.
